definitions.explanation: The act of drawing or painting objects, landscapes, or people as they appear in real life.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}で{花|はな}の{写生|しゃせい}をした。
examples.english: I sketched flowers in the park.

examples.japanese: {美術|びじゅつ}の{授業|じゅぎょう}で{写生|しゃせい}{大会|たいかい}があった。
examples.english: There was a sketching contest in art class.

examples.japanese: {風景|ふうけい}{写生|しゃせい}が{趣味|しゅみ}です。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{写生|しゃせい}する (to sketch from life)
・{写生|しゃせい}{大会|たいかい} (sketching contest)
・{写生|しゃせい}{帳|ちょう} (sketchbook)
・{風景|ふうけい}{写生|しゃせい} (landscape sketching)
・{人物|じんぶつ}{写生|しゃせい} (figure drawing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・スケッチ - sketch (loanword, similar meaning)
・デッサン - drawing (from French, often basic drawing practice)
・{描|か}く - to draw/paint (general)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{写生|しゃせい}{大会|たいかい} (sketching contests) are common school activities in Japan, where students go outdoors to draw from nature.
